description_en: Modifies the logon configuration of a bound identity provider in a specified workspace. DingTalk and Lark support the logon switch, incremental synchronization switch, application configuration, and synchronization scope. CustomSSO supports SAML configuration and the logon switch. Updates take effect asynchronously. Call GetIdentityProvider to query the status
description_zh: 修改指定工作空间已绑定身份源的登录配置。DingTalk、Feishu 支持登录开关、增量同步开关、应用配置和同步范围；CustomSSO 支持 SAML 配置和登录开关。实际更新异步生效，请通过 GetIdentityProvider 查询状态
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore update-identity-provider --workspace-id ws-example --identity-provider-type CustomSSO --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateIdentityProvider

parameters.help_en: Required. The ID of the destination workspace. The region of the request must be the same as the region of the destination workspace
parameters.help_zh: 必填，目标 Workspace 的标识；请求地域需与目标 Workspace 一致
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: General CRUD operations support DingTalk, Lark, and CustomSSO. SP queries support only CustomSSO. The SCIM path uses the CustomSSO shared pool
parameters.help_zh: 通用 CRUD 支持 DingTalk、Feishu、CustomSSO；SP 查询仅支持 CustomSSO。SCIM 路径固定使用 CustomSSO 共享池
parameters.name: identity_provider_type

fields.help_en: Do not pass true during CustomSSO initialization. A valid SAML configuration must be saved before enabling. Disabling does not delete the configuration. In case of asynchronous failure, this expected value does not mean that it has taken effect upstream
fields.help_zh: CustomSSO 初始化时不传 true；启用前须保存有效 SAML 配置。关闭不删除配置。异步失败时该期望值不代表上游已生效
fields.name: login_enabled

fields.help_en: The Lark App ID. It can be omitted during an update to retain the saved value. The merged Lark configuration of the old and new values must contain this item
fields.help_zh: 飞书 App ID。更新时可省略并保留已保存值；新旧值合并后的飞书配置须包含此项
fields.name: app_id

fields.help_en: The DingTalk AppKey. It can be omitted during an update to retain the saved value. The merged DingTalk configuration of the old and new values must contain this item
fields.help_zh: 钉钉 AppKey。更新时可省略并保留已保存值；新旧值合并后的钉钉配置须包含此项
fields.name: app_key

fields.help_en: The provider application secret. If omitted during an update, the saved value is retained. You can submit this field separately to update the secret. The explicit value cannot be empty. It is sensitive input and is not echoed in the response
fields.help_zh: 厂商应用密钥。更新时省略保留已保存值，可单独提交此字段更新密钥；显式值不能为空。敏感输入，响应不回显
fields.name: app_secret

fields.help_en: The DingTalk enterprise CorpId. It can be omitted during an update to retain the saved value. The merged DingTalk configuration of the old and new values must contain this item
fields.help_zh: 钉钉企业 CorpId。更新时可省略并保留已保存值；新旧值合并后的钉钉配置须包含此项
fields.name: corp_id

fields.help_en: Required when synchronization is enabled for DingTalk and Lark. It is sensitive input and is unrelated to the SCIM token
fields.help_zh: DingTalk、Feishu 开启同步时必填，敏感输入；与 SCIM Token 无关
fields.name: encrypt_key

fields.help_en: Required when synchronization is enabled for DingTalk and Lark. It is sensitive input and is unrelated to the SCIM token
fields.help_zh: DingTalk、Feishu 开启同步时必填，敏感输入；与 SCIM Token 无关
fields.name: verification_token

fields.help_en: The provider configuration for DingTalk and Lark supports partial updates. Omitted fields retain the saved values. Submitted values cannot be null, empty strings, or whitespace strings. The complete configuration is verified after merging. CustomSSO updates use protocol and saml, and do not accept this field. The returned value does not contain provider keys
fields.help_zh: DingTalk、Feishu 的厂商配置支持部分更新：省略字段保留已保存值，提交值不得为 null、空串或空白串，合并后校验完整配置。CustomSSO 更新使用 protocol、saml，不接受此字段；返回值不含厂商密钥
fields.name: metadata

fields.help_en: The logon protocol for CustomSSO. Only SAML is supported. You can pass SAML when saving the SAML configuration. You can omit this field if you only modify loginEnabled. DingTalk and Lark do not accept this field
fields.help_zh: CustomSSO 登录协议，当前仅支持 SAML。保存 SAML 配置时可传入 SAML；只修改 loginEnabled 时可省略。钉钉、飞书不接受此字段
fields.name: protocol

fields.help_en: HTTP-Redirect or HTTP-POST. Required for manual entry. The query returns the short name
fields.help_zh: HTTP-Redirect 或 HTTP-POST；手填时必填，查询返回短名称
fields.name: binding_type

fields.help_en: Required for manual entry. It must be non-empty and contain up to 2,048 characters. The existing configuration cannot be replaced. It is different from the local entity ID queried by the SP
fields.help_zh: 手填时必填，非空且不超过 2048 字符；已有配置不支持更换。与 SP 查询的我方 Entity ID 不同
fields.name: entity_id

fields.help_en: Required for manual entry. It must be an absolute HTTPS URL and cannot contain user credentials or fragments
fields.help_zh: 手填时必填，为绝对 HTTPS URL，不含用户凭据和片段
fields.name: login_url

fields.help_en: The input is the XML text of a single IdP EntityDescriptor. The maximum size is 1 MiB. It cannot be a URL or file path. It is mutually exclusive with the four manual entry fields. DTD and external entities are prohibited. If both SSO bindings are declared at the same time, HTTP-POST takes precedence
fields.help_zh: 输入为单个 IdP EntityDescriptor 的 XML 文本，最大 1 MiB，不是 URL 或文件路径；与四个手填字段互斥，禁止 DTD 和外部实体；同时声明两种 SSO Binding 时优先 HTTP-POST
fields.name: metadata_xml

fields.help_en: Required for manual entry. It must be a non-empty array using PEM X.509 certificate text. The current validity period is verified. Up to two certificates are allowed after deduplication
fields.help_zh: 手填时必填非空数组，使用 PEM X.509 证书文本；校验当前有效期，去重后最多 2 张
fields.name: x509_certificates

fields.help_en: The SAML configuration for CustomSSO. Choose either metadataXml or the four manual entry fields: entityId, loginUrl, bindingType, and x509Certificates. If not submitted, the existing configuration is retained. DingTalk and Lark do not accept this field
fields.help_zh: CustomSSO 的 SAML 配置。metadataXml 与 entityId、loginUrl、bindingType、x509Certificates 四个手填字段二选一；未提交时保留已有配置。钉钉、飞书不接受此字段
fields.name: saml

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable incremental synchronization for subsequent directory change events of DingTalk or Lark. If not passed, the original value is retained. It does not control the initial synchronization or manual synchronization. CustomSSO does not accept this field. You must use UpdateIdentityProviderSCIM
fields.help_zh: 是否开启钉钉或飞书后续通讯录变更事件的增量同步。未传保持原值，不控制首次同步或手动同步。CustomSSO 不接受此字段，须使用 UpdateIdentityProviderSCIM
fields.name: sync_enabled

fields.help_en: For SelectedDepartments, it must contain at least one non-empty department ID, which should be obtained from ListIdentityProviderDepartments. For AllAuthorized, pass an empty array or omit it
fields.help_zh: SelectedDepartments 时至少包含一个非空部门 ID，应取自 ListIdentityProviderDepartments；AllAuthorized 时传空数组或省略
fields.name: department_ids

fields.help_en: AllAuthorized: All authorized scopes, subject to application directory authorization restrictions. SelectedDepartments: Selected departments and all sub-departments. When explicitly submitting syncScope, a valid mode must be provided and verified by the backend
fields.help_zh: AllAuthorized：全部授权范围，受应用通讯录授权限制；SelectedDepartments：选中部门及所有子部门。显式提交 syncScope 时必须提供有效 mode，由后端校验
fields.name: mode

fields.help_en: Follows the definition of the department-based synchronization scope. If omitted during creation, the default is AllAuthorized. The initial provider synchronization is determined by syncOnBind. If omitted or set to null during an update, the original value is retained. Updating and saving the scope does not automatically execute a full synchronization
fields.help_zh: 沿用按部门同步范围定义；创建省略默认 AllAuthorized，首次厂商同步由 syncOnBind 决定；更新省略或 null 保留原值，更新保存范围不自动执行全量同步
fields.name: sync_scope

parameters.help_en: Submit business parameters as described in this operation. The body parameters of public APIs are mapped to backend wrappers by the gateway. Do not mix them with backend direct connection body wrappers
parameters.help_zh: 按本接口说明提交业务参数；公开 API 的 body 参数由网关映射到后端包装，不混用后端直连 body 包装
parameters.name: body

code.description_en: The business result code. If the request fails, use this code in combination with the HTTP status code and the message for troubleshooting
code.description_zh: 失败时结合 HTTP 状态及 message 处理

data.description_en: The business result. For the result structure, see the response parameters of this API operation. For asynchronous write operations, the response indicates that the request is accepted, but does not guarantee that the background task is completed
data.description_zh: 结果结构见本接口返回字段；异步写接口的返回表示受理，不保证后台任务已完成

configuration.description_en: The actual upstream configuration. The actual SAML configuration is read on demand only when you call the GetIdentityProvider operation. SCIM queries and preparations return the actual receiving status and URL
configuration.description_zh: SAML 实际配置只在 GetIdentityProvider 按需回读；SCIM 查询和准备返回实际接收状态及 URL

bindingType.description_en: HTTP-Redirect or HTTP-POST. Required for manual entry. The query returns the short name
bindingType.description_zh: HTTP-Redirect 或 HTTP-POST；手填时必填，查询返回短名称

entityId.description_en: Required for manual entry. It must be non-empty and contain up to 2,048 characters. The existing configuration cannot be replaced. It is different from the local entity ID queried by the SP
entityId.description_zh: 手填时必填，非空且不超过 2048 字符；已有配置不支持更换。与 SP 查询的我方 Entity ID 不同

loginUrl.description_en: Required for manual entry. It must be an absolute HTTPS URL and cannot contain user credentials or fragments
loginUrl.description_zh: 手填时必填，为绝对 HTTPS URL，不含用户凭据和片段

ssoStatus.description_en: The actual SSO logon status. The actual switch value is Enabled or Disabled, which is not equivalent to the expected loginEnabled value saved in AC
ssoStatus.description_zh: 实际开关值 Enabled 或 Disabled，不等同 AC 保存的 loginEnabled 期望值
ssoStatus.title_en: AgentIdentity 实际 SSO 登录状态
ssoStatus.title_zh: AgentIdentity 实际 SSO 登录状态

identityProviderType.description_en: General CRUD operations support DingTalk, Lark, and CustomSSO. SP queries support only CustomSSO. The SCIM path uses the CustomSSO shared pool
identityProviderType.description_zh: 通用 CRUD 支持 DingTalk、Feishu、CustomSSO；SP 查询仅支持 CustomSSO。SCIM 路径固定使用 CustomSSO 共享池

loginEnabled.description_en: Do not pass true during CustomSSO initialization. A valid SAML configuration must be saved before enabling. Disabling does not delete the configuration. In case of asynchronous failure, this expected value does not mean that it has taken effect upstream
loginEnabled.description_zh: CustomSSO 初始化时不传 true；启用前须保存有效 SAML 配置。关闭不删除配置。异步失败时该期望值不代表上游已生效

protocol.description_en: The logon protocol for CustomSSO. Only SAML is supported. You can pass SAML when saving the SAML configuration. You can omit this field if you only modify loginEnabled. DingTalk and Lark do not accept this field
protocol.description_zh: CustomSSO 登录协议，当前仅支持 SAML。保存 SAML 配置时可传入 SAML；只修改 loginEnabled 时可省略。钉钉、飞书不接受此字段

saml.description_en: The SAML configuration for CustomSSO. Choose either metadataXml or the four manual entry fields: entityId, loginUrl, bindingType, and x509Certificates. If not submitted, the existing configuration is retained. DingTalk and Lark do not accept this field
saml.description_zh: CustomSSO 的 SAML 配置。metadataXml 与 entityId、loginUrl、bindingType、x509Certificates 四个手填字段二选一；未提交时保留已有配置。钉钉、飞书不接受此字段

bindingType.description_en: HTTP-Redirect or HTTP-POST. Required for manual entry. The query returns the short name
bindingType.description_zh: HTTP-Redirect 或 HTTP-POST；手填时必填，查询返回短名称

entityId.description_en: Required for manual entry. It must be non-empty and contain up to 2,048 characters. The existing configuration cannot be replaced. It is different from the local entity ID queried by the SP
entityId.description_zh: 手填时必填，非空且不超过 2048 字符；已有配置不支持更换。与 SP 查询的我方 Entity ID 不同

loginUrl.description_en: Required for manual entry. It must be an absolute HTTPS URL and cannot contain user credentials or fragments
loginUrl.description_zh: 手填时必填，为绝对 HTTPS URL，不含用户凭据和片段

x509Certificates.description_en: Required for manual entry. It must be a non-empty array using PEM X.509 certificate text. The current validity period is verified. Up to two certificates are allowed after deduplication
x509Certificates.description_zh: 手填时必填非空数组，使用 PEM X.509 证书文本；校验当前有效期，去重后最多 2 张

items.description_en: A valid PEM X.509 signing certificate. The example is a public test certificate for idp.example.com. You must replace it with the certificate of the external IdP for actual access
items.description_zh: 一张有效 PEM X.509 签名证书；示例为 idp.example.com 的公开测试证书，实际接入须替换为外部 IdP 的证书

status.description_en: The status of the identity source resource and logon configuration. For CustomSSO, a shared pool status of READY does not mean that SAML is configured. For SCIM, query operationStatus independently for the operation result
status.description_zh: CustomSSO 共享池 READY 不等于已配置 SAML；SCIM 操作结果独立查询 operationStatus
status.title_en: 身份源资源及登录配置状态
status.title_zh: 身份源资源及登录配置状态

syncEnabled.description_en: Specifies whether synchronization is enabled. Do not pass true when initializing CustomSSO. You can update this parameter only by calling the UpdateIdentityProviderSCIM operation. Determine the result in combination with operationStatus
syncEnabled.description_zh: CustomSSO 初始化时不传 true；后续只能通过 UpdateIdentityProviderSCIM 更新，结果结合 operationStatus 判断

syncScope.description_en: Follows the definition of the department-based synchronization scope. If omitted during creation, the default is AllAuthorized. The initial provider synchronization is determined by syncOnBind. If omitted or set to null during an update, the original value is retained. Updating and saving the scope does not automatically execute a full synchronization
syncScope.description_zh: 沿用按部门同步范围定义；创建省略默认 AllAuthorized，首次厂商同步由 syncOnBind 决定；更新省略或 null 保留原值，更新保存范围不自动执行全量同步

departmentIds.description_en: For SelectedDepartments, it must contain at least one non-empty department ID, which should be obtained from ListIdentityProviderDepartments. For AllAuthorized, pass an empty array or omit it
departmentIds.description_zh: SelectedDepartments 时至少包含一个非空部门 ID，应取自 ListIdentityProviderDepartments；AllAuthorized 时传空数组或省略

items.description_en: The unique identifier of the department returned by the identity provider, obtained from ListIdentityProviderDepartments
items.description_zh: 身份源返回的部门唯一标识，取自 ListIdentityProviderDepartments

mode.description_en: AllAuthorized: All authorized scopes, subject to application directory authorization restrictions. SelectedDepartments: Selected departments and all sub-departments. When explicitly submitting syncScope, a valid mode must be provided and verified by the backend
mode.description_zh: AllAuthorized：全部授权范围，受应用通讯录授权限制；SelectedDepartments：选中部门及所有子部门。显式提交 syncScope 时必须提供有效 mode，由后端校验

syncScope.title_en: 已配置的同步范围；历史有效配置缺省为 AllAuthorized，损坏的历史配置可能不返回此字段
syncScope.title_zh: 已配置的同步范围；历史有效配置缺省为 AllAuthorized，损坏的历史配置可能不返回此字段

workspaceId.description_en: Required. The ID of the destination workspace. The region of the request must be the same as the region of the destination workspace
workspaceId.description_zh: 必填，目标 Workspace 的标识；请求地域需与目标 Workspace 一致

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code of the current request. This status code indicates the processing status of the request and does not represent the final result of the background task
httpStatusCode.description_zh: 本次请求的处理状态，不等同后台任务最终结果

message.description_en: Task result message. It indicates whether the request is accepted or returns an error message. For asynchronous tasks, check task results by calling the corresponding query API operation
message.description_zh: 请求受理或错误消息；异步任务结果需按对应查询接口核对

requestId.description_en: The request ID. Retain this ID for troubleshooting and to correlate with the current API call if the request fails
requestId.description_zh: 用于关联本次调用与排障，失败时请保留

success.description_en: Indicates whether the current request is successful. A value of true indicates that the request is processed successfully. For asynchronous write operations, you must continue to query the task result
success.description_zh: true 表示本次请求处理成功；异步写入仍需继续查询任务结果
